mapper.select: SELECT id, work_id, content, is_checked, image_url, image_filename, order_num, created_at FROM work_checklists WHERE work_id = #{workId} ORDER BY order_num ASC, created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_checklists (work_id, content, is_checked, image_url, image_filename, order_num, created_at) VALUES (#{workId}, #{content}, #{isChecked}, #{imageUrl}, #{imageFilename}, #{orderNum}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE work_checklists SET content = #{content}, is_checked = #{isChecked}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, image_filename = #{imageFilename}, order_num = #{orderNum} WHERE id = #{id}
